item.title: PSV and Ajax earn over €50 million in UEFA Champions League ahead of final group games
item.description: Ahead of their final group match, PSV has earned close to 43 million euros in revenue from their UEFA Champions League campaign. Ajax has collected nearly 42 million euros in UEFA bonuses.

item.title: Experts clash on appeal in murder of Ukrainian sex worker Arina Sasina
item.description: Two pathologists involved in the case of a man convicted of the rape and murder of 34-year-old Ukrainian sex worker Arina Sasina have reached conflicting conclusions about Sasina's cause of death.

item.title: Four Afghan women granted asylum in the Netherlands after earlier rejections
item.description: Four Afghan women who had sought asylum in the Netherlands will be allowed to stay, despite earlier rejections of their applications.

item.title: Most parents want mandatory helmets on e-bikes, but teens disagree
item.description: Roughly 80 percent of parents support the implementation of a national law that would require minors to wear a helmet when riding an e-bike, including fatbikes.

item.title: Rotterdam police seize €41,000 hidden throughout man’s clothing
item.description: Rotterdam police stopped and searched a man at around 10:20 p.m. Monday, who had 41,000 euros in cash concealed throughout his clothing, seizing the money, police said on Instagram.

item.title: Appeal starts in sedition case against far-right Dutch MP Gideon van Meijeren
item.description: Today, the appeal starts in the sedition case against parliamentarian Gideon van Meijeren of the far-right FvD.

item.title: Snow: Multiple icy roads accidents in north Netherlands
item.description: Snow and icy roads have led to accidents in several places in the north of the Netherlands overnight and early Wednesday morning.
